text.p: Argentina took a big step towards next year's World Cup in France as they beat weakened Paraguay 2-1 away in a South American qualifying match Sunday.
First-half goals by Marcelo Gallardo and Juan Veron sunk Paraguay, who suffered their first home defeat for four years. Roberto Acuna replied for the home team with a second-half penalty.
Paraguay, who still look certain to qualify for the World Cup in France next year, stayed top of the single South American World Cup group with 23 points from 11 games.
Argentina, second in the group, closed the gap on Paraguay to one point but have played a game more. The top four teams go to France.
Paraguay were without captain and goalkeeper Jose Luis Chilavert, who was serving the second of a four-match suspension imposed after he was sent off against Colombia for fighting.

Argentina, the last team to win in Asuncion in 1993, were clearly relieved not to have to confront the menacing goalkeeper, who scored from a free kick when the teams drew their first game in Buenos Aires last year.
The home side were also missing injured defenders Francisco Arce and Catalino Rivarola and striker Miguel Benitez.

Gallardo, who missed two penalties during last month's Copa America in Bolivia, appeared to have little chance of scoring from a 30th minute free kick which was taken around 15 meters from the goal line on the right side of the Paraguay area.
But his weak, curling effort went over the Paraguay wall, bounced in front of goalkeeper Ruben Diaz and sneaked in at the near post.

The Paraguayans had barely recovered from that blow when Veron struck 11 minutes later, after being set up by Hernan Crespo. His first shot was blocked on the line by Carlos Gamarra, but Veron got to the rebound first to score.
An eery silence descended on the usually intimidating Defenders of the Chaco stadium after the goal.
Paraguay, a shadow of the team that won all their previous home games in the competition, made a match of it when Acuna, taking the penalty in Chilavert's absence, scored in the 58th minute.
But the Argentine defence held firm in the closing stages, despite having Hernan Diaz sent off four minutes from time.

Paraguay - 22-Ruben Ruiz Diaz, 4-Carlos Gamarra, 5-Celso Ayala, 19-Ricardo Rojas, 8-Francisco Esteche (20-Derlis Soto, 46), 14-Juan Jara, 6-Estanislao Struway, 16-Julio Enciso (12-Jorge Alcaraz, 73), 10-Roberto Acuna, 18-Aristides Rojas, 9-Jose Cardozo.

Argentina - 1-Carlos Roa, 4-Hernan Diaz, 2-Roberto Ayala, 6-Roberto Sensini, 3-Jose Chamot, 8-Diego Simeone, 5-Matias Almeyda, 11-Juan Veron (15-Javier Zanetti, 53), 10-Marcelo Gallardo (13-Pablo Paz, 87), 9-Hernan Crespo (20-Sergio Berti, 75), 7-Claudio Lopez.
